truenas-readonly.comment: Recommended starting point: stdio, certificate verified, no tool can change the system.

truenas-full.comment: Full tool surface with the most dangerous operations denied. Remove --deny-tools once you trust the setup.

truenas-http.comment: Streamable HTTP transport, for clients that cannot spawn a subprocess. Start the server with: truenas-mcp --truenas-url truenas.local --http-addr 127.0.0.1:8089
